title: Book Two · Chapter 167: The Folded Edge
story:
At home, Ronan puts all six practice pages on his bed. He places them in order. The fourth paper is longer than the others.

He opens its folded edge.

The mark is there. HELP. Beside it, Miss Wu's note says that Leo found the line about the desk.

Ronan presses the fold flat with his palm. It rises a little when he takes his hand away. He presses it again.

The teacher made a mistake in the new table. He did not change a mark. He did not ask anyone to write four beside his name.

He puts the six papers in two groups. The first, third, and fifth go on the left. He did those three tasks well without help. The second, fourth, and sixth go on the right.

Three on each side.

He moves the fourth page to the left. For a moment, there are four there, just as the wall record says. His answer on that page is correct. He can explain the plan now without help.

But Leo found the line during the task. Ronan remembers his own question. Can you help me find the desk?

He moves the page back.

Mum knocks at the open door. “Food in ten minutes.”

“Yes.”

She looks at the papers. “Do you need the table?”

“No. I have room.”

She leaves. Ronan takes a small piece of paper and writes Miss Wu at the top. Under it, he starts a sentence about the fourth practice.

He stops after the word fourth.

If he tells her, the total goes back to three. His name will come off the shortlist too. Even weeks of extra practice cannot give him a place in this final round.

If he says nothing, perhaps no one will unfold the page again. The final tasks will be new. If he does them well, he can tell himself that he belongs there.

He looks at the two groups on his bed. He still needs to choose. The right number is still three.

Dad calls from the kitchen. Ronan puts the six pages back in his folder. He keeps the small note underneath them.

At dinner, Mum asks about his number work. He answers that question. Dad asks him to pass a plate. He passes it.

No one asks about the reading record.

After dinner, Ronan returns to his room. He unfolds the fourth page once more. Then he opens his school book on top of it and tries to finish his ordinary work.

He reads the same question three times. Outside, someone shuts the green door. Ronan lifts the book and looks at the HELP mark again.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

fold＝折痕、折起处；palm＝手掌；belong＝属于、够资格在其中；underneath＝在下面。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样用六张原纸确认了真实结果？
2. 他怎样为保持沉默寻找理由？

## 读句子

**He moves the page back.**

拆开看：He / moves / the page back.

他／把那张纸／移回原处。
